I'm checking whether the documentation mentions any prebuilt Docker images for deployment. The deployment guide references GHCR images, but I can't find specific names in the docs, so I'd need to build the image locally using Docker instead. The build process will be resource-intensive since it involves npm ci and Playwright with Chromium, which could take some time.

My plan is to pull the MongoDB image, build the backend image locally, then create a compose file that ties together the backend and database on the shared network. I'll seed it with an admin account, create a tenant and bookable resource, set up a booking for today, and update the display server's environment to point at the new backend. The display server should then be able to sign in and serve the resource data.

I'm also realizing I need to check how the tenant parameter in API routes gets resolved — whether it expects a slug or ID — since the display server will need to construct the correct URL for fetching bookables and bookings.I need to build the backend from source since there's no documented GHCR name, so I'll start by checking how the `:tenant` parameter resolves.
